description: This file implements core functions for a SLAP (Service Logic Aggregation Plane) Bmc2 Server Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization. It defines how to set up and manage the server object within the system, with functions such as SlapBmc2SrvoCreate, SlapBmc2SrvoRemove, SlapBmc2SrvoEnrollObjects, and SlapBmc2SrvoInitialize.

classes.name: SLAP_BMC2_SERVER_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing the SLAP Bmc2 Server Object, extending base component object and including specific members for object management.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapBmc2SrvoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new SLAP Bmc2 Server Object, setting function pointers and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapBmc2SrvoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the SLAP Bmc2 Server Object, freeing resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapBmc2SrvoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls all required objects for the SLAP Bmc2 Server Object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapBmc2SrvoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes member variables and functions for the SLAP Bmc2 Server Object, including setting function pointers and object properties.
